LESSON: SURAH

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.2: Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Surah. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite correctly Surah Fatiha (Suggested time: 5 lessons) as a Holy Book and small groups. 178
2. appreciate reciting Surah Fatiha during Swalah. the Qur’an e.g. not placing other books/items on it.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recite correctly Surah Fatiha (Suggested time: 5 lessons) as a Holy Book and small groups. 178
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite correctly Surah Fatiha (Suggested time: 5 lessons) as a Holy Book and small groups. 178. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate reciting Surah Fatiha during Swalah. the Qur’an e.g. not placing other books/items on it.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate reciting Surah Fatiha during Swalah. the Qur’an e.g. not placing other books/items on it. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Surah.
2. Explain Surah to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Surah.
4. Show that you can: recite correctly Surah Fatiha (Suggested time: 5 lessons) as a Holy Book and small groups. 178
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Surah. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Surah important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recite correctly Surah Fatiha (Suggested time: 5 lessons) as a Holy Book and small groups. 178
2. appreciate reciting Surah Fatiha during Swalah. the Qur’an e.g. not placing other books/items on it.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
